0022600185.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, 0-2 at home) host the Los Angeles Lakers (5-2) on a six-game losing streak, sitting fifth in the Pacific and 15th in the West, while the Lakers are first in the Pacific and fourth in the West after winning their last game. Out for the Kings are Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle, averaging 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes this season), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated; averaged 12.5 points and 26.5 minutes last season), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 128-104 defeat in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026.
